_about: Station-check decisions read by code/05_write_paragraphs.py, in the form of the STATION_CHECK and
CONFIRMED tables of the original writer (archive/klara_c40_metrics_2026-10-31/code/06_write_paragraphs.py,
October 2026 station check, notebook Section 39). Keys are "City|SEASON|variable".
kind: none (no trend is quoted: 'show no clear long-term trend' / 'no clear long-term trend in station records'),
uncertain (humidity: 'may have risen, but station records do not confirm it'), value (humidity: the station
rate in 'value' is quoted instead of ERA5's), slight_decline (rainfall: 'declined slightly, though station
records do not show the decline clearly'), unverified (rainfall: the ERA5 trend is quoted with 'a trend that
station records cannot yet confirm' when p < 0.05; wet_day_share entries are recorded but no sentence reads them).
A humidity entry of kind none or uncertain also drops the humidity outlook clause; a rainfall entry of kind
unverified or slight_decline adds 'partly because of an uncertain long-term drying trend' to a drier outlook.
text replaces the generated trend sentence outright. note is the reviewer note written under the paragraph.
The 'shared' block applies under every rule set; 'legacy' and 'new' add to or replace it for that set.
confirmed lists humidity trends that weather stations confirm ('a change weather-station records confirm').
